info.title: MyLINK WhatsApp API
info.description:
Purpose and functionality

MyLINK WhatsApp API is a REST-based API that supports sending WhatsApp messages to the recipients you want to reach.

Current supported functionality

  • Send WhatsApp messages
    • Send a text WhatsApp message
    • Send a WhatsApp message with media (image, video, document, sticker, location)
    • Send an interactive WhatsApp message (containing list, catalogue, flow, carousel and more)
    • Send a WhatsApp template message (authentication, marketing or utility)
  • Receive WhatsApp messages
  • Receive Delivery reports for sent messages
  • Create/Update/Delete and Retrieve templates via API

In order to start sending on WhatsApp you must first create a template message. This process is mandated by Meta to improve the relevancy and trust consumers have in their inbox messages; ultimately filtering out potential spam content that reduces that channel's popularity amongst consumers. LINK can help you create templates. You can also follow this documentation on how to do it.

Getting started

To maximise the deliverability of your WhatsApp messages first you need to make sure that your configuration is correctly set up. The following steps are crucial for the success of your integration:

  • Get in touch with us to get a demo or sign up for the product: Click here
  • Accept your invitation to the MyLINK portal to generate your API secrets - simply go to the Messaging APIs page in the navigation menu, select the myLINK WhatsApp API product and generate your credentials(clientId and secret)
  • Revisit the developer portal for how to send a WhatsApp message

All needed values for the configuration can be found on the Messaging APIs page in MyLINK. Once ready, revisit the developer portal for how to send WhatsApp messages.

tags.name: Send messages
tags.description:
The API allows you to send messages to this endpoint regardless of message type, but the content of the JSON message body differs for each type of message. See the defined schema for building your desired message type or check our examples below:

Text messages

Text messages are messages containing only a text body and an optional link preview.

Example
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "text",             
				"text": {             
					 "body": "I am typing a text to test this"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
	"callback": {            
		"mode": "URL",            
		"urls": [                 
			"https://webhook.site/b8d8d417-00cc-4046-b428-cf0caafabd19"             
		],              
		"ttl": 0         },         
	"referenceId": "reference-no-1",         
		"priority": "Normal"     
	 } 
]

Media messages:

Media messages can be sent in two ways:

  1. By providing a publicly available media link.
  2. (Recommended) By uploading the media through the Media Upload endpoint and referencing the file using its generated media ID in your message.
Below are examples demonstrating both approaches.

Image messages

Image messages are messages that display a single image and an optional caption.

Supported image format:

  • .jpeg
  • .png

Example with link
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "image",             
				"image": {             
					 "link": "https://i.pinimg.com/originals/8d/53/33/8d53339fee9bb43e7ba5db4a9455d783.jpg"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4d253417-0cb7-44b8-9468-268bbf2ef2a4"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]
Example with media ID
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "image",             
				"image": {             
					 "id": "634516282819190", 
					 "caption": "Movie night!"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4479ec41-d6c2-4ae0-8f07-90627b9b0801"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 1000       
		} 
	 } 
]

Audio messages

Audio messages display an audio icon and a link to an audio file. When the WhatsApp user taps the icon, the WhatsApp client loads and plays the audio file.

Supported audio format:

  • .aac
  • .mp4
  • .amr
  • .mpeg
  • .ogg (codex=opus)

Example with link
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "audio",             
				"audio": {             
					 "link": "https://filesamples.com/samples/audio/mp3/sample4.mp3"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4d253417-0cb7-44b8-9468-268bbf2ef2a4"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]
Example with media ID
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "audio",             
				"audio": {             
					 "id": "183756660685928"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4479ec41-d6c2-4ae0-8f07-90627b9b0801"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 1000       
		} 
	 } 
]

Video messages

Video messages display a thumbnail preview of a video image with an optional caption. When the WhatsApp user taps the preview, it loads the video and displays it to the user.

Supported video format:

  • .mp4
  • .3gpp

Example with link
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "video",             
				"video": {             
					 "link": "https://devlcmlcontent.blob.core.windows.net/wamedia-test/sample_640x360.mp4"            
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4d253417-0cb7-44b8-9468-268bbf2ef2a4"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]
Example with media ID

		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",

			"media": {            
				"type": "video",             
				"video": {

				}            
			},

			],              
			"ttl": 1000       
		} 
	 } 
]

Document messages

Document messages are messages that display a document icon, linked to a document, that a WhatsApp user can tap to download.
Supports any MIME-type document.

Example with link
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "document",             
				"document": {             
					 "link": "https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf",
					 "caption": "This is an important pdf file",  
					 "filename": "This is an important pdf file"           
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		},        
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4d253417-0cb7-44b8-9468-268bbf2ef2a4"

			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]

			],              
			"ttl": 1000       
		} 
	 } 
]

Sticker messages

Sticker messages display animated or static sticker images in a WhatsApp message.

Example
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"stickerId": "1241022987536359",             
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		}, 
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [                 
				"https://webhook.site/4d253417-0cb7-44b8-9468-268bbf2ef2a4"                 
			],              
			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]

Contact messages

Contacts messages allow you to send rich contact information directly to WhatsApp users, such as names, phone numbers, physical addresses, and email addresses.

Location messages

Location messages allow you to send a location's latitude and longitude coordinates to a WhatsApp user.

Example
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "location",             
				"location": {             
					 "longitude": 18.0739497 
					 "latitude": 59.3120499    
					 "name": "Linkmobility Stockholm, Sweden"    
					 "address": "Götgatan 78, Stockholm, Sverige"      
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		}, 
		"callback": {            
			"mode": "URL",            
			"urls": [

			],              
			"ttl": 0       
		} 
	 } 
]

Template messages

A predefined message used to initiate conversations. The templates are registered andapproved in the Facebook Business Manager. Templates are used to send campaigns to end users. You can see how to manage templates in the section below.

Example text template
[
	{         
		"recipient": "{{msisdn}}",        
		"content": {            
			"media": {            
				"type": "template",             
				"template": {             
					 "name": "test_template",    
					 "language":{ 
						 "code" : "en"
					},   
					 "components":[{ 
						 "type": "body", 
						 "parameters": [
						{ 
							"type":"text", 
							"text":"This is a template text message" 
						}] 
					}]       
				}            
			},            
			"options": {            
				"sender": "{{whatsAppSender}}"            
			}        
		}        
	 } 
]

tags.name: Manage templates
tags.description:
Template messages

WhatsApp message templates are predefined formats that businesses use to send notifications or customer service messages to users who have opted in. These messages can cover topics such as appointment reminders, shipping details, issue resolution, or payment updates.

Before sending a template message, you need to create a template. Please view how to do this via API in our Template management section or login to your Whatsapp business manager and use the Create template button.

You can see guidelines on how to create a template if the official Meta documentation here: https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2055875911147364?id=2129163877102343

You can send the following message types:

  • Text-based message templates
  • Media-based message templates
    • Image
    • Audio
    • Video
    • Document
    • Sticker
  • Interactive message templates
  • Location-based message templates
  • Authentication message templates

tags.name: Media upload
tags.description:
You can use the Media Upload API to securely upload media files to Meta in encrypted format. Once uploaded, the API returns a media ID, which you can then use to send media in campaigns or when replying to messages from end-user All media files sent through this endpoint are encrypted and persist for 30 days, unless they are deleted earlier.You can upload the following formats below

Audio

Audio Extension MIME Type Max Size
AAC .aac audio/aac 16 MB
AMR .amr audio/amr 16 MB
MP3 .mp3 audio/mpeg 16 MB
MP4 Audio .m4a audio/mp4 16 MB
OGG Audio .ogg audio/ogg (OPUS codecs only; base audio/ogg not supported; mono input only) 16 MB

Document

Document Type Extension MIME Type Max Size
Text .txt text/plain 50 MB
Microsoft Excel .xls application/vnd.ms-excel 50 MB
Microsoft Excel .xlsx application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet 50 MB
Microsoft Word .doc application/msword 50 MB
Microsoft Word .docx application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document 50 MB
Microsoft PowerPoint .ppt application/vnd.ms-powerpoint 50 MB
Microsoft PowerPoint .pptx application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation 50 MB
PDF .pdf application/pdf 50 MB

Image

Images must be 8-bit, RGB or RGBA.

Image Type Extension MIME Type Max Size
JPEG .jpeg text/jpeg 5 MB
PNG .png image/png 5 MB

Sticker

WebP images can only be sent in sticker messages.

Sticker Type Extension MIME Type Max Size
Animated sticker .webp image/webp 500 KB
Static sticker .webp image/webp 100 KB

Video

Only H.264 video codec and AAC audio codec supported. Single audio stream or no audio stream only.

Video Type Extension MIME Type Max Size
3GPP .3gp video/3gpp 16 MB
MP4 Video .mp4 video/mp4 16 MB

post.description:
To receive Delivery Reports (DLR) and Mobile Originated WhatsApp (MO) successfully to your endpoint you need to open up for the following IPs:

  • 20.86.255.57
  • 4.245.97.148

WhatsApp Message Delivery Lifecycle via API

  1. Queued
    • Meaning: Message has been accepted by the API and is waiting to be sent.
    • Webhook Status: queued
  2. Sent
    • Meaning: Message has been successfully sent from the WhatsApp API.
    • Webhook Status: sent
  3. Delivered
    • Meaning: Message has reached the recipient’s device.
    • Webhook Status: delivered
  4. Read
    • Meaning: Recipient has opened/read the message.
    • Webhook Status: read
These delivery status updates are sent to your webhook endpoint, allowing you to track the message journey in real time.

post.description:
Mobile originated (MO) for WhatsApp can be used to interact with the end-user, and can be done in several ways.

First of all, you need access to a type of number to receive MO’s on your product. Currently, you can use

  • Long number
    • Long number is a number in MSISDN format used for receiving messages.
    • The long number from each country reflects the actual number length relevant for the country it is issued in.
    • Long number may be used internationally

Example
[
	{
		"reply": {
			"replyTo": null,  
			"sender": "{sender.number}", 
			"routerId": "rdC7ay8c", 
			"routeKeyword": "", 
			"text": "Text",          
			}            
		}, 
		"eventId": "24fde05d-0933-4042-b77b-e32d976a6915",

			"timestamp": "2025-07-16T09:54:46Z", 
			"code": null,

]
